tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs lū hi pa'i lugs yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'bar ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs lū hi pa'i lugs yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'bar ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rnam bcas sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar gyis mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde ba sdom// rnam med rdo rje btsun mos rab 'khyud dga' ba'i ro la rtag tu rol// rnam kun mchog ldan bde stong zung 'jug gzod nas yongs grub gshis sam babs// rnam 'dren rdo rje'i slob dpon mchog dang tha dad med khyod spyi bor bsnyen// pre ta pu ri'i 'dren pa rnams kyis sdom pa'i sgrub thabs nak+ṣa traḥ /mtha' yas bkra yang grub chen gzhung bzang tshong 'dus chu dang 'o ma bzhin/ /'dir ni kun tu lū hi pa'i mtshan/ dge ba'i legs bshad ngan lhad dri mas ma bslad par// gang yin de yi dgongs 'grel gyis brgyan de ring bsnyad do 'di ya mtshan| |gal te dngos grub mchog dam pa// 'dod na 'khrul pa'i lam dor la// rnam dag grub chen gzhung bzang po// 'di nyid mi bsten su zhig yod| |thog ma kho nar dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas/ rgyud kyi le'u bcu gsum par/ dbang gi lha mo mchod bya ste// dpa' bo'i lha mo bka' bsgo skyes// longs spyod yan lag kun spyod ma// 'khor ba las sgrol gtso bo yin// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i grogs dang bcas pas/ dur khrod dam/ rtags gcig pa'am/ khang stong ngam/ shing gcig pa la sogs pa'i gnas su nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad 'du byas la/ kha lhor phyogs pas skra grol ro'i gdan la bde bar 'dug la bdud rtsi ril bu yod na khar bcug med na thod par gnas pa'i ma da na/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hes bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las thod pa/

de'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga dang*/ bi mū shu ma ra las bdud rtsi lnga gnas pa/ de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ oṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥste rigs lngas mtshan pa'i a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis kha bkab pa'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum ste rigs gsum pa'i steng du/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i rdo rje rtse dgu pa hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyi phreng ba can gyis mtshan pa ni gsang ba chen po drug pa'i bdag nyid can no// yi ge bzhi po de las 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug so so la thim/ rlung g.yos me sbar bskol ba rdo rjes dkrugs pas sha la sogs pa rnams dang*/ zla ba dang*/ yi ge dang*/ rdo rje rnams zhu ba rdzas la thim zhing*/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ gyis sbyangs dag par byas shing spel te bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ zhes byin gyis brlabs pa mtheb srin gyis blangs nas myang zhing*/ oṃ a mṛ ta swā da swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ skabs 'dir rgya gzhung gzhan gsum po so sor gtor ma 'bul ba ma bshad la/ slob dpon a bha yas 'khrul spong du/ 'dir thog mar rang nyid lhor mngon par phyogs shing skra grol bas gtor ma dbul bar byas la/ zhes 'byung bas/ spro na/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin brlabs/ kha kha khā hi'i sngags gsum gyis 'bul la/ mchod pa byin rlabs rgya gzhung gang du'ang 'dir ma bshad pas med mi rung min la/ spro na byas kyang rung ngam snyam mo// de nas/ shrī zhes bya ba gnyis su med pa'i ye shes so// he zhes bya ba ni rgyus stong pa'o// ru zhes bya ba ni tshogs pa dang bral ba'o// ka zhes bya ba ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o// sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i rgyur bdag dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba yin no// zhes dang*/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das sdom pa zhes bya ba/

zhal gcig /phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i lte bar/ oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/ 'od zer dang ldan pas g.yon skor lan gsum yongs su bskor ba las/ 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros pas bgegs thams cad bcom zhing brlag par gyur/ sdug bsngal gsum ldan sems can la// 'khor ba bsgral 'dod snying rje ste| |rang gi bsod nams gzhan phan la// rang ba'i sems nyid dga' ba ste// chags dang bral ba byams pa nyid// thams cad don byed btang snyoms so// zhes tshangs gnas bzhi bsgom/ de nas phung khams skye mched kyi dag pa bsgom pa ni/ rang nyid kyi gzugs su rung ba bcu gcig la sogs pa gzugs kyi phung po'i gnas kyi gtso bo mgo bo'i dbus su buṃ las rnam snang dkar po/ g.yas 'khor lo 'phyar zhing g.yon bsgyings pa dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ tshor ba bco brgyad la sogs pa tshor ba'i phung po'i gnas kyi gtso bo lte bar aṃ las rdo rje nyi ma ser po| khams bco brgyad kyi khyad par 'dzin pa sogs 'du shes kyi phung po'i rtsa bar gyur pa mgrin par hrīḥlas pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po/ sems byung thams cad kyi rten rlung ste/ 'du byed kyi phung po'i gnas rkang pa'i long bu gnyis kyi 'og tu hoḥlas rdo rje rgyal po ljang gu rnams rim bzhin g.yas rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dmar po dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje rnams shin tu bsgyings pa dang bcas pas 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pa rnams dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa dang yid kyi dbang po'i rten srog gi rlung ste/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po'i gnas snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/

g.yas bsgyings pa dang bcas pas thugs kar rdo rje dang*/ g.yon snyems pa dang bcas pas dril bu dkur bzhag pa/ spyi gtsug tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid la hi las dpal he ru ka nag po g.yas sa gnon gyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon ting 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas dril bu 'dzin pa/ mig gnyis la oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po/ g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon bsgyings pa dang bcas pas dril bu thugs kar phyogs pa/ rna ba gnyis la hūm̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar phyogs shing*/ g.yon bsgyings pa dang bcas pas dril bu dkur bzhag pa/ sna bug gnyis la trāṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ser po/ lce la aṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po/ dpral bar khaṃ las ser sna rdo rje ljang gu rnams rim bzhin g.yas rin po che dang pad+ma dmar po dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje rnams sgeg pa dang bcas pa 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pa rnams bsgyings pa dang bcas pas dril bu thugs kar phyogs pa/ snying gar haṃ las dbang phyug rdo rje dkar po/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar phyogs shing*/ g.yon bsgyings pa bcas pas dril bu dkur bzhag pa/ lte bar sa dkyil la lāṃ las sa'i khams la ltung byed ma ser mo/ g.yas dang pos 'khor lo/ snying gar chu dkyil la māṃ las chu'i khams gsod byed la nag mo/ g.yas dang pos rdo rje/ mgrin par me dkyil la pāṃ las me'i khams la 'gugs byed ma dmar mo/ g.yas dang pos pad+ma/ dpral bar rlung dkyil la trāṃ las rlung gi khams la pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma ljang gu/ g.yas dang pos ral gri/ bzhi ga g.yas gnyis pas gri gug /g.yon dang pos thod pa/ gnyis pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas su mkha' dkyil la khaṃ las nam mkha'i khams la pad+ma dra ba can ma chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin sku dang rtsa zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yon gsum thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ zhags pa/ g.yas gsum gyis gri gug

/tshangs mgo/ lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa rnams ni zhabs g.yon brkyangs pas bzhugs shing ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum pa phyag rgya rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa/ lha mo rnams gcer bu skra grol ba g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o// srung 'khor ni/ g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis se gol phyogs so sor gtog cing*/ shar du oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa nag po/ byang du oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ljang gu/ nub tu oṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa dmar po/ lhor oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ser po rnams sa chen po nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du khyab par sngags kyi lus chen po rab tu 'bar ba dang*/ de'i mdog can gyi ra ba'i ngos bzhi dang*/ de dang dus mnyam par 'og tu hūm̐ las byung zhing des byin gyis brlabs pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje las sa chen po'i mthar thug par sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhir gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūm̐/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'od zer gyis steng dang phyogs thams cad du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rang bzhin gyi ra bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pra kā ra hūm̐ paṃ hūm̐/ ra ba'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa mde'u can gyi mda'i dra bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i gur du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pañja ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ gur gyi 'og tu rdo rje'i bla brer gyur/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ phyi rol tu rdo rje 'bar ba'i byin za dum bu gcig tu 'bar zhing 'khrugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ slar se gol sngags bcas gong bzhin la/ rdo rje'i ra ba dang me'i ra ba'i bar du phyogs bzhir sngags re re las g.yon skor du/ shar du khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/

nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lhor phag gdong ma ser mo rnams dang*/ slar se gol dang sngags gnyis gnyis brjod cing*/ mtshams bzhir sngags gnyis gnyis 'dres pa las/ shar lhor gshin rje sreg ma g.yas nag g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya g.yas ser/ g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ma g.yas dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang*/ g.yon nag pa/ steng du khwa gdong ma nag mo| 'og tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo bcu ga'ang zhal gcig /phyag gnyis/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i tho ba dang*/ g.yon pas rang 'dra'i phur bu 'dzin pa spros shing bskul bas song ste phyogs bcur gnas pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bkug /sgra ring po brjod pa'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi ra ba dang nye ba'i 'obs kyi nang du bcug |oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ bigh+nāṃ kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lha mo bcu'i phyag g.yon pa'i phur bu bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor btab/ oṃ badz+ra mud+ga ra badz+ra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje'i tho bas brdungs pas bgegs kyi tshogs de rnams de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pa'i rang bzhin bde ba chen pos gnas par gyur/ slar yang bgegs lhag ma rnams bskrad de lha mo rnams ra ba la thim pas chu rlabs kyi tshogs brdabs pa la zegs ma 'thor ba bzhin du phyogs mtshams bcing bar bya ba'i rdo rje nag po dang*/ pad+ma dmar po dang*/ 'khor lo dkar po'i ra ba zlum po bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pas 'gro ba gzhan rnams kyang bgegs dang bral bar gyur par bsam/ de nas tshogs bsag pa ni/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su rang 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po 'od zer sna tshogs rnam par 'phro ba/

de'i snang bas bla ma dang sangs rgyas tha mi dad pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor pa'i rnam pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro khyod la 'dud// mkha' 'gro ma yis 'khor lo bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum ldan| |'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag bya/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur par bsam/ de yang pi wang ma gling bu ma rnga zlum ma rdza rnga ma rnams sngo ser dmar ljang*| phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis rang rtags kyi rol mo dkrol zhing mtha' gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pa/ bzhad ma glu ma gar ma bzhi dmar sngo ser ljang*/ bzhad ma'i phyag dang po gnyis bzhad pa'i stangs dang*/ sgeg ma'i phyag dang po gnyis sgeg pa'i stangs kyis rdor dril/ glu ma'i phyag dang po gnyis pheg rdeb pa/ gar ma'i phyag dang po gnyis gar bsgyur ba/ bzhi ga'i phyag tha ma gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ/ me tog ma bdug pa ma mar me ma dri ma rnams dkar mo dud kha mar me'i rtse lta bu dmar mo/ g.yas dang po rnams me tog dang bdug spos dang mar me'i sdong bu dang dri'i dung chos/ g.yas tha ma ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ/ gzugs ma ro ma reg ma chos ma bzhi dkar dmar ljang dkar/ phyag g.yas dang pos me long sbrang chang gi snod gos sna tshogs chos 'byung*/ g.yas tha ma ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa sprul la/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ waṃ she/ mṛ taṃ ge/ mu rañje/ hā s+ya/ lā s+ya/ gī ti/ nṛ t+yai/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ oṃ rū pa badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ra sa/ spar+she/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sbyar bas mchod/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis// bdag gi lus ngag yid sgo nas// sdig pa bgyid bstsal yi rang gang*// de dag rgyal ba'i mdun du bshags// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bsod nams gang*| |gzhan yang rdzogs pa'i byang chub brten rnams gang*// rang sangs rgyas dang bla ma mchog rnams kyi// bsod nams de dag kun la rjes yi rang*// dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad ni// mtha' yas phyogs khyab thugs rje yon tan ldan// chos can skyon bral 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// bdag nyid gus pas skyabs su nye bar mchi// rgyal bas yongs su dag pa'i yang dag lam bstan nas// tshangs dbang drag po sogs kyis rin thang med pa rnyed// 'di ltar bdag gis nye bar bsod nams tshogs las ni// byang chub mchog sems de ni rab tu bskyed par bgyi// bgrod dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las// bdag gis 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// rang gis bdag nyid skad cig la// sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs so// tshogs zhing rang la bstim pa rgya gzhung lnga gar ma gsungs pas ma bsdus kyang chog la/

bsdu na snying gar bstim mam rang gnas su gshegs so// de nas| rang gi dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga rnams su/ he ru ka zhes pa'i yi ge gsum gsal bar gyur/ chos thams cad rgyu dang bral ba de ltar rtog pa dang bral ba gang du'ang mi gnas pa zhes bya ba nges par spyad nas/ tshul de ltar ma shes pa'i sems can rnams ni bdag dang bdag gir la sogs par bzung nas 'khor bar 'khyams te/ de rnams bdag gis dpal he ru kar bsgyur nas chos rnams tshul 'di ltar thams cad kyis shes par bya'o// zhes chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje bskyed nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i stong pa nyid du rnam par dag go// de yang sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis rang gi sems nyid oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar sngo ba gong nas gong du brtsegs thabs su gnas pa'i oṃ las sku'i 'khor lo/ āḥlas gsung gi 'khor lo/ hūm̐ las thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha yab yum rnams spros te 'gro ba thams cad kyi don byas/ lha yab yum snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas zhu ba yi ge gsum la thim/ de yang oṃ āḥl/ āḥhūm̐ la thim zhing*/ hūm̐ yig zhabs kyu la/ de ha la/ ha mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la thim zhing*/ nā da yang skra'i rtse mo brgya stong gi cha tsam du gyur/ de yang sems can thams cad chos nyid khong du ma chud pas 'khor bar gyur te/ bdag gis chos nyid khong du chud pas de rnams kyis rtogs par bgyi'o// zhes dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'i sa bon du gyur par bsgoms te/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ nā da yang shin tu phra bar gyur nas mi dmigs par gyur| ces dar cig stong nyid bsgom/ slar yang rang gi sems nā da'i gzugs kyis nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu lta bu rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/

de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po zur gsum pa 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las rin po che'i rang bzhin ri rab lhun po brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes pa/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa/ shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i lte bar paṃ ljang gu las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ze ba dang snying po dang ldan pa/ de'ang 'dab ma phyogs bzhir dmar zhing ge sar dang me rlung ser po/ lte ba dang bden bral ljang gu/ dbang ldan nag po'i mdog can du gyur pa'i lte bar/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba la/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ dkar po phrag gnyis g.yon skor du gnas pa me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ḍa ḍha da dha ya la dmar po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba la/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ḍa ḍha da dha ya la dmar po phrag gnyis g.yas su bskor ba mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ zhes pa ni rnal 'byor ro// rang gi rnam par shes pa nam mkhar nā da'i rnam par gnas pa skad cig gis zla nyi dkar dmar bde ba chen po'i dbus su zhugs ma thag hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dang bcas par gyur pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin de las byung ba'i kha dog lnga po'i 'od zer 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs phyogs thams cad du spros/

'gro ba rnams de'i rang bzhin du byas te sdud pa'i tshe thog ma med pas grub pa phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i grub pa thob pa dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa thams cad shes rab dang thabs kyi mnyam par sbyor bas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du zhu bar byas nas skad cig gis bkug pa sa bon dang phyag mtshan la thim pa nan tan ye shes/ mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin gyi sa bon de mngon sum gyi rgyur byas te/ de nyid bcom ldan 'das rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin can no// zhes pa ni rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ */ zla nyi sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal he ru ka 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa| dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i tshul du rdzogs pa ste dpal he ru ka nga'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags lan gsum brjod la/ bcom ldan 'das shin tu rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin can no// de yang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rūṃ yig las byung ba rig ma dang bcas pa'i rnam par snang mdzad kyi bdag nyid thub pa'i dbang po'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'phros ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ phyi nas dkar/ ser/ dmar/ ljang*| sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu dmar po dbyibs sna tshogs pa'i nor bus spras pa/ de'i steng du dra ba'i snam bu la gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi'i ngos su chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas byung ba'i mu tig gi do shal dang*/ do shal phyed pa nor bu dang dril bu rnga yab kyis mdzes par 'phyang ba/ do shal gyi nang du pad zla dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ rin po che dang*/

rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng bya 'dab las thur du 'phyangs pa'i rin po che'i shar bu dkar po/ de'i steng gi phyogs rnams su pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi mda' yab la rin po che'i bum par gnas pa'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan brgyad kyi rtse mor seng ge dang*/ mkha' lding sogs kyis mtshan pa/ rlung gis skyod pa'i tshe sum khugs su 'khyog cing dril chung gi sgra sgrog pa/ mda' yab kyi grwa bzhir rin po che'i gdugs bzhis mdzes pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol gyi rtsa ba'i stegs bu pad+ma rā ga'i rang bzhin can grwa dang sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams rnams su zla phyed rdo rjes spras pa la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo du mas mchod par byed pa/ ngos kyi dbus su sgo bzhi'i steng du rta babs sgo tshad gsum la snam bu bcu gcig pa'i nang phyogs kyi mdog can la rnam par bkra ba'i bla bre dang do shal gyis brgyan pa/ phyi rol tu sna tshogs pa'i dar dpyangs dang rnga yab dang ba dan dang rgyal mtshan sgreng ba/ rta babs kyi steng du pad zlar gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo gser mdog rtsibs bcu gnyis pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo 'gram pa bteg pa'i mig 'khor lo'i rtse mo la blta ba/ de dag gi 'khor du spre'us bzung ba'i zla tshes rdo rje'i rtse mo can gyi gdugs dkar dmar rnams kyis mdzes pa/ rta babs kyi gzhogs rnams su bum pa bzang po las thon pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing rin po che sna bdun dang ldan pa/ bar bar du grub pa thob pa rnams dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba bzung ba sprin gyi sbubs nas lus phyed thon pa'i lha'i bu dang bu mo sogs kyis mngon par dga' ba/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi phyed du rdo rje'i phreng ba 'od zer dang bcas pa zlum pos bskor ba la brten pa'i ka ba phyogs mdog dang rigs kyi mtshan mas spras pa rnams kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gis rim bzhin mdzes par phub pa'i thog gi dbus byur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/

nang gi steng 'og thams cad shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba/ sgo'i nang gi logs re rer gser gyi bum pa re re ste brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sku 'khor dkar po rtsibs brgyad/ rtsibs bar rnams phyogs mtshon/ mu khyud la 'khor lo dkar po'i phreng ba can gyi steng du gsung 'khor dmar po rtsibs brgyad/ rtsibs bar rnams dkar po/ mu khyud la pad+ma dmar po'i phreng bas bskor ba'i steng du thugs 'khor sngon po rtsibs brgyad/ rtsibs bar rnams dmar po/ mu khyud la rdo rje nag po'i phreng bas bskor ba'i steng du bde chen 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ mu khyud la gri gug gi phreng bas bskor ba'i ze'u 'brur nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba'i steng du dbang phyug 'jigs byed nag po/ spyan gsum/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa g.yon du mnan pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ tha ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ u ma de wī dus mtshan ma dmar mo/ zhal gcig |phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ tha ma gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing g.yas su mnan pa/ de gnyis kyi steng du rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa/ sku dang rtsa zhal nag po/ zhal lhag ma g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi gnyis pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa'i na bza' mnabs pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa sgreng ba/ phyag g.yon pa'i gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bzhi pa na khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/

ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can mi mgo rlon pa'i phreng ba 'phyang ba/ rus chen gyi mgur chu/ gdu bu/ gdub kor/ 'khor lo dang nor bus brgyan pa/ mchod phyir thogs dang thal chen gyis byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug rnam par dag pas rgyas btab pa/ de'i mdun du bcom ldan 'das ma mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum skra sgrol ba/ gcer mo thod pa'i dum bu'i 'og pag gis brgyan pa/ thod pa bdud khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas pas phyogs bcur gnas pa'i sdang ba kun la rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub sdigs par byed pa/ bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid che zhing khrag 'dzag pa la dgyes pa byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khril ba/ bde ba chen po'i thugs rje'i bdag nyid can no// yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ dkar po las rdo rje nag po la bya dmar po las nor bu cung zad dmar ba yi ge bya ser pos rdo rje'i rtse mor byin gyis brlabs pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa la d+yaṃ las dpa' bo'i byang chub kyi sems nye bar mtshon pa can ze'u 'bru dkar po yi ge d+yaṃ ser pos rtse mor byin gyis brlabs pa/ yab kyi lte bar/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ snying gar/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lkog mar/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ dpral bar/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bkod nas bcom ldan 'das ma la bcom ldan 'das kyis tsum+ba na bya/ yum gyi lte bar/ oṃ shrī badz+ra= snying gar/ oṃ hrīḥ= lkog mar/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro= dpral bar/ oṃ sarba bud+dha= bkod la bcom ldan 'das la bcom ldan 'das mas tsum+ba na bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yab yum dga' ba brtsams shing snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/

ces dga' ba brtsam/ slar yang bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab ma shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo rnams dngos grub thams cad rab tu sgrub par mdzad ma/ zhal gcig /spyan gsum/ skra grol ba/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i zhal can gcer mo phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan pa/ phyag g.yon dang pos thod pa/ gnyis pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /g.yas dang pos ḍā ma ru/ gnyis pas gri gug 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gis nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir byang chub kyi sems la sogs pas gang ba'i snod bzhi dang bcas pa/ thugs 'khor gyi rtsibs shar pūl+li ra ma la yar thod pa'i dum bu dang rab gtum mo/ byang dzā lan+dha rar keng rus chen mo dang gtum mig ma/ nub u rgyan du keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ lho arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ me gau da wa rir lha dgra dang dpa' ba'i blo gros ma/ bden bral ra me shwa rar snang ba dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ rlung de wī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ dbang ldan ma la war rdo rje'i lus dang shing grib ma rnams te/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams sku mdog sngon po/ gsung 'khor gyi rtsibs shar ka ma rū par myu gu can dang sa srung ma/ byang o ṭer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi phyogs ma/ lho ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ ka ra dang chang 'thung ma/ me ka liṅkar rab tu bzang mo dang sngo bsangs lha mo/ bden bral laṃ bā kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ rlung kañcir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ dbang ldan hi mā la yar mig mi bzang dang mkha' 'gro bya gdong ma rnams te/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams sku mdog dmar po/ sku 'khor gyi rtsibs shar pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs ma/

byang gṛ ha de war rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/ nub sau rāṣ+ṭar rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ lho su war+ṇa dwīpar nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ me nā ga rar dpal khrag 'thung dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bden bral sin+dhu rar pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs po che ma/ rlung ma rur rnam par snang byed dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ dbang ldan ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo rnams te/ sku'i 'khor lo'i lha thams cad sku mdog dkar po'o// thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa'i dpa' bo nyer bzhi po ni zhal gcig /phyag bzhi pa/ spyan gsum pa ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis mtshan pa'i cod pan can/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang rang gi rnal 'byor ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yon gnyis pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /g.yas gnyis pas ḍā ma ru 'dzin cing phyag rgya lnga la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rab gtum la sogs pa'i lha mo nyer bzhi po ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing g.yas pas sdang ba rnams la sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas gri gug 'phyar ba/ spyan gsum ma drag mo'i gzugs can skra grol ba la rnam par mdzes ma/ gnyis su med par sbyor ba la snyoms par zhugs pa/ phyogs kyi gos mchog 'chang ba/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gtsug phud dang*/ dpung rgyan dang*/ rna cha dang*/ gdub kor dang*/ tshangs skud 'chang ba/ dpa' bo rnams la mi mgo rlon pa dang*/ dpa' mo rnams la thod skam gyis mgul rgyan byas pa/ 'og pag sil sil gyi sgra sgrog pa'o// shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang mo/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ mer gshin rje brtan ma g.yas nag /g.yon ser ba/ bden bral du gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser/ g.yon dmar ba/ rlung du gshin rje mche ba can ma g.yas dmar/

g.yon ljang ba/ dbang ldan du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang*/ g.yon nag pa/ brgyad ka'ang zhal gcig spyan gsum| mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing skra grol ba phrag rgya lngas spras pa/ phyag g.yon dang pos thod pa/ gnyis pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /g.yas dang pos ḍā ma ru/ gnyis pas gri gug 'dzin pa/ gcer mo g.yas brkyangs pas yi dwags kyi gdan la gnas pa 'jigs par byed pa chen mo'o// 'khor lo lnga'i lha yab yum thams cad dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng ba dang bcas pa sems can gyi don sna tshogs pa mdzad pa la brtson pa'o// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba ste/ shar gyi dur khrod gtum drag tu shir+ṣa'i shing*/ phyogs skyong brgya byin ser po rdo rje dang thod pa thogs nas glang po che rab brtan la zhon pa/ nor rgyas dkar po gdengs ka ut+pal sngon pos mtshan pa thal mo sbyar ba sprin sgra sgrog la gnas pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs par a shwat+tha'i shing*/ lus ngan ser po ne'u le skyug pa dang thod pa thogs nas mi la zhon pa/ 'jog po ser po dpal be'us mtshan pa thal sbyar sprin smug 'jigs khra bo la gnas pa/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar bas khyab pa kaṃ ka la'i shing*/ wa ru ṇa dkar po thod pa dang zhags pa thogs nas chu srin la zhon pa/ stobs rgyu dmar po mgrin par ri mo gsum pa thal sbyar sprin drag po dmar po la gnas pa/ lhor 'jigs su rung bar tsū ta'i shing*/ gshin rje nag po mig dmar lus sbom drag po be con thogs nas ma he la zhon pa/ pad+ma dmar po ston pa'i bka' sdod cing dbu la thig mang pos mtshan pa thal sbyar sprin 'khyil pa sngon po la gnas pa/ dbang ldan du ha ha rgod par parti ba'i shing*/ dbang phyug dkar po stag sham can rtse gsum dang thod pa thogs nas glang la zhon pa/ pad+ma chen po dkar po gdengs ka rtse gsum gyis mtshan pa thal sbyar sprin stug po dkar la gnas pa/

byin zar dpal gyi nags tshal du bha ḍa'i shing*/ me lha dmar po bongs thung thod pa phreng ba spyi byugs thogs nas ra skyes la zhon pa/ ha lu ru rma bya'i mgrin pa lta bu'i kha dog can mgo la pad+mas mtshan pa ser po la gnas pa/ bden bral du mun pa drag por ka rañja'i shing*/ srin po sngon po gcer bu mi mgo'i phreng ba'i cod pan can ral gri thogs nas ro la zhon pa/ rigs ldan nag po gdengs ka zla phyed kyis mtshan pa thal sbyar sprin char 'bab kham nag la gnas pa/ rlung du ki li ki li sgrog par parka ṭī'i shing*/ rlung lha dud mdog ba dan ser po dang thod pa thogs nas sha ba la zhon pa/ dung skyong dkar po mgor thig les mtshan pa thal sbyar sprin gtum pa mthing nag la gnas pa/ shing rnams me tog dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa| phyogs skyong rnams rang rang gi chung ma dang bcas pa phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal sbyar/ tha ma gnyis rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa/ sprin rnams glog 'khyug cing 'brug gi sgra 'byin pa char rgyun 'bab pa/ phyogs bdag rnams kyis bzhon pa'i gdong brnyan can gyi srin po la sogs pa zhing skyong rnams rang bzhin 'khrug cing mi rnams kyi sha la za zhing khrag la 'thung ba dag shing rnams kyi ngos la gnas pa/ gzhan yang mchod rten dang*/ ri dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ lha dang*/ grub pa thob pa brgyad brgyad dang*/ seng ge dang*/ ce spyang dang*/ khyi rnams sgra sgrog pa/ stag dang*/ wa dang*/ phag dang*/ nya wo rkyang dang*/ bri ka dang*/ sbrul dang*/ khwa dang*/ 'ug pa la sogs pa sna tshogs pa dang*/ ro bsal shing la bskyon pa dang*/ mdung gis phug pa dang*/ keng rus dang*/ phyed dang*/ mgo rus dang*/ thab tu tshig pa dang*/ phyed tshig pa dang*/ sha za dang*/ ro sgrub byed dang*/ ro langs dang*/ grub pa thob pa gtor ma ster ba dang*/ rnal 'byor ma mchog tshogs mchod pa dang*/ gri gug dang*/ thod pa dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/

rnge'u chung dang*/ kha zas kyi snod thogs pa la sogs pa dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ sha za/ yi dwags/ 'byung po/ ro langs gar byed pa la sogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i bkod pa 'jigs su rung bas yongs su bskor ba'o| |zhes rten dang brten pa ji lta ba nges pa rnyed rnyed kyi bar du bsgom zhing gsal snang thon par bya'o// de nas de dag byang phyogs so bdun lha'i sbyor bas sbyor ba ni/ lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma/ tshor ba dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni lā ma/ chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni dum skyes ma/ sems dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o// 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rab gtum ma/ brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa gtum mig ma/ spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa 'od ldan ma/ sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa sna chen ma'o// dad pa'i dbang po dpa' ba'i blo gros ma/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po mi'u thung ma/ dran pa'i dbang po laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po shing grib ma'o// shes rab kyi dbang po sa srung ma/ dad pa'i stobs 'jigs byed chen mo/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs rlung shugs ma/ dran pa'i stobs chang 'thung ma'o// ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs sngo bsangs lha mo/ shes rab kyi stobs shin tu bzang mo/ ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag rta rna ma/ brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag mkha' 'gro bya gdong ma'o// dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag 'khor lo'i shugs ma/ shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dum skyes ma/ chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag sna can ma/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o| |btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag shin tu dpa' mo/ yang dag pa'i lta ba stobs chen ma/ yang dag pa'i rtogs pa 'khor los bsgyur ma/ yang dag pa'i ngag brtson 'grus chen mo'o// yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' khwa gdong ma/

yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba 'ug gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba khyi gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i dran pa phag gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka rdo rje'o// dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams skyed pa gshin rje sreg ma/ dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par srung ba gshin rje pho nya ma/ mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spong ba gshin rje mche ba ma/ mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi bskyed pa gshin rje 'joms ma yin no// zhes dran par bya'o| |de nas gnas la sogs pa rim par sbyar ba sa bcu rnam par dag pa bsgom pa ni/ rang gi spyi bo la sogs pa gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir/ pū dzā u a gau ra de ma/ ka o tri ko ka laṃ ka hi/ pre gṛ sau su nā si ma ku/ zhes pa'i yi ge rnams so sor thig les mtshan pa gnas de dang de dag tu yongs su gyur pa las/ gnas rnams kyis rtsa rnams rtsibs med pa'i 'khor lo'i rnam par skad cig gis blta zhing*/ gnas la sogs pa rnams la de dang de'i gnas kyis rtsa rnams kyi de dang de lta nyid kyi tshul du yongs su gyur nas lhar gnas par gyur pa ni/ pūl+li ra ma la ya mgo bor rab gtum ma/ dzā lan+dha ra spyi gtsug tu gtum mig ma/ u rgyan rna ba g.yas par 'od ldan ma/ arbu ta mgo bo'i rgyab tu sna chen ma rnams ni sa rab tu dga' ba'o// gau da wa ri rna ba g.yon par dpa' ba'i blo gros ma/ ra me shwa ra smin mtshams la mi'u thung ma/ de wī ko ṭa mig gnyis la laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ ma la wa phrag pa gnyis la shing grib ma rnams ni nye ba'i gnas te sa dri ma med pa'o// 'di dag ni thugs kyi 'khor lo ste mkha' la spyod ma'o// ka ma rū pa mchan khung gnyis su sa srung ma/ o ṭe nu ma zung la 'jigs byed chen mo gnyis ni zhing ste sa 'od 'byed pa'o// tri sha ku ne lte ba la rlung gi shugs ma/ ko sa la sna'i rtse mor chang 'thung ma gnyis ni nye ba'i zhing ste sa 'od 'phro ba'o// ka liṅka kha la sngo bsangs lha mo/

laṃ bā ka mgul par shin tu bzang mo gnyis ni tshan+dho ha ste sa shin tu sbyang dka' ba'o// kañci snying gar rta rna ma/ hi mā la ya lgang par mkha' 'gro gdong ma gnyis ni nye ba'i tshan+dho ha ste sa mngon du gyur pa'o// de rnams ni gsung gi 'khor lo ste sa la spyod ma'o// pre ta pu ri mtshan mar 'khor lo'i shugs ma/ gṛ ha de wa bshang lam du dum skyes ma gnyis ni 'du ba can ste sa ring du song ba'o// sau rāṣ+ṭa brla gnyis la sna chen ma/ su war+ṇa dwīpa byin pa zung la 'khor lo'i go cha ma gnyis ni nye ba'i 'du ba can ste sa mi g.yo ba'o// nā ga ra sor mo rnams la shin tu dpa' mo/ sin+dhu rkang pa'i bol la stobs chen ma gnyis ni dur khrod ste sa legs pa'i blo gros so// ma ru mthe bong bzhi la 'khor los bsgyur ma/ ku lu ta pus mo zung la brtson chen ma gnyis ni nye ba'i dur khrod ste sa chos kyi sprin no| |de rnams ni sku'i 'khor lo ste sa 'og na spyod ma'o// khar khwa gdong ma/ sna bug g.yas par 'ug gdong ma/ bshang lam du khyi gdong ma/ sna bug g.yon par phag gdong ma/ rna ba g.yon par gshin rje sreg ma/ rna ba g.yas par pho nya ma/ mig g.yas par mche ba ma/ mig g.yon par 'joms ma ste brgyad ni dam tshig gi 'khor lo ste grong dang grong gi mtha' na spyod ma'o// snying ga dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ lte ba dang*/ dpral ba'i pad+ma'i lte ba rnams su ni/ mkha' 'gro ma/ lā ma/ dum skyes ma/ gzugs can ma bzhi ste bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o| |spyi bor chu skyes kyi steng du bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems rdo rje de lha thams cad dang mnyam par 'khyud pa/ gsang ba'i pad+mar khrag rdo rje phag mo shin tu chags pa'i yid kyis 'khyud pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin mngon sum du nyams su myong ba'o// rang gi spyi bo la sogs pa'i rtsa rnams su 'bab pa'i khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/

sen mo dang po dag ni thod pa'i dum bu can skra dang spu dag ni keng rus chen po/ pags pa dang dri ma keng rus/ sha la mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ rgyus pa la lha dgra/ rus pa la snang ba dpag med| mchin pa la rdo rje 'od/ snying la rdo rje lus po/ mig gnyis la myu gu can/ mkhris pa la rdo rje ral pa can/ glo ba la dpa' bo chen po/ rgyu ma la rdo rje hūm̐ ka ra/ mnye ma la rab tu bzang mo/ grod pa la rdo rje bzang po/ bshang ba la 'jigs byed chen po/ mtshog srub la mig mi bzang ngo*// bad kan la stobs po che/ rnag la rin chen rdo rje/ khrag la rta mgrin/ rngul la nam mkha'i snying po/ tshil la dpal khrag 'thung*/ mchi ma la dpal gar gyi dbang phyug /mchil ma la rnam par snang byed/ snabs la rdo rje sems dpa' rnams ni dpa' bo'i yan lag rnam par dag pa'o// zhes dang*/ rgyan chas sngags su dag par sbyor ba ni/ dpa' bo'i rtsa ba'i sngags sogs gang*// tshangs skud la sogs dag tu btags// dpa' bo'i go cha drug po yis// phyag rgya 'di dag lus mdzes pa'o// rdo rje phag mo'i gsang sngags gang*// mgur chus mgrin pa brgyan pa yin// lha yi snying po'i sngags kyis ni// phreng ba brgya phyed kyis brgyan to// yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags kyi// gdub kor gyis ni rna ba brgyan// sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ */ pags pa'i gos mchog 'dzin pa ste// rnal 'byor ma drug gsang sngags kyis// ska rags byas pas brgyan pa'o// 'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i// sngags ni btung ba'i thod pa ste// rnam snang mdzad ma'i sngags gang yin// thod pa yis ni dbu la brgyan// ces dang*/ rkang pa gnyis kyi 'og ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can/ sum mdo'i phyogs su gnas pa ni me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa/ gsus par chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po'i dbyibs can/ snying gar sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/

sgal tshigs dbyug pa'i tshul/ stod ri rgyal lhun po'i rnam pa/ spyi bor pad 'dab so gnyis dbyangs gsal gyi rnam pa byang chub kyi chos sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i dbus na klad pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su haṃ yig thig le'i rang sgra sgrog pa/ rten dang brten pa'i tshul can 'jig rten kun gyi brtan dang g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gsal dang mi gsal ba'i tshul gyis 'dzag pa bdud rtsi'i tshul nyid kyis rnam par gnas pa/ nyin mo bcom ldan 'das/ mtshan mo rnal 'byor ma/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lha'i sku/ ḍā ma ru shes rab kyi sgra/ shrī zhes bya ba gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ he ni rgyu la sogs pa stong pa nyid/ ru ni bkod pa dang bral ba/ ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa nyid do// zhes so so'i don dran bzhin pas yun ring du bsgom mo// de nas sku gsung thugs kyi dbye bas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi rang bzhin las/ mtho ris dang*/ mi yul dang*/ sa 'og tu spyod pa'i 'khor lo gsum po bdag nyid kyi lus kyi 'khor lo gsum dang skad cig gi rnam pa'i sbyor bas bdag dang rnal 'byor ma dag kun nas kun tu skad cig gi bde ba chen po ye shes kyi rang bzhin du dbyer med pa nyid do// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyer med du bsam/ de nas go cha bgo ba ni/ yab kyi snying gar oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ dkar dmar nag pa'i zhal phyag g.yas gsum rdo rje dang*/ ḍā ma ru/ mgo bo/ g.yon gsum dril bu/ thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ mgor na ma hi las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ phyag g.yas dang pos pad+ma/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po las pad+ma gar dbang dmar po/ g.yas dang pos pad+ma/ phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣaṭa he las he ru ka nag po/ g.yas dang pos rdo rje/ mig gnyis su huṃ hūm̐ hoḥlas rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser/

g.yas dang pos rin po che/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ las rta mchog ljang gu/ g.yas dang pos ral gri/ thams cad kyang g.yas gnyis pas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon dang pos dril bu/ gnyis pas ka pā la dang bcas pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa zhal gcig pa'o// yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ dmar sngo ljang ba'i zhal phyag /g.yas gsum gri gug /lcags kyu/ mgo bo/ g.yon gsum thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ zhags pa bsnams pa/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ khar hrīṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ mgo bor hriṃ hrīṃ las skyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa las gtum mo dud kha thams cad kyang zhal gcig pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis ḍā ma ru dang gri gug /g.yon gnyis thod pa dang bcas pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de ltar go cha'i lha thams cad spyan gsum pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ mdog dkar po rnams zla ba'i rgyab yol dang gzhan rnams nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor can no// de nas mdzub mo gnyis mdud/ gung mo gnyis rtse sbyar/ gzhan rnams so sor bsgrengs/ mthe bong rdo rje bsdams/ rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong g.yon pa'i mthe bos mnan mig gyen du blta/ phyag rgya de nyid dpral ba'i dbyes su g.yon dang g.yas dang dbus su lan gsum gsum bskor zhing*/ pheṃ/ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig nag po kun nas 'bar ba dri ma med pa'i 'od zer sna lnga glog gi phreng ba ltar phyogs thams cad du spros pas/ sa 'og sa steng sa blar spyod pa'i 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ba dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug rnams kyi skur grub pa yongs su gyur pa'i rang bzhin phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa na bzhugs pa thams cad dang*/ dbang gi lha gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor dam tshig pa la spyan drangs pa'i dkyil 'khor ye shes pa rnams skad cig la dgug gzhug bcing mnyes dbang du byas nas myur bar bstims pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ lag pa g.yon pa dang g.yas dag g.yon g.yas su lan gsum gsum bskor zhing mthar 'khyud rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos thams cad dang shes rab gnyis su dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin nyid du gzod nas dag la/ bdag kyang de nyid kyi ngo bor gdod nas dag go// zhes nga rgyal bya/ ye shes pa dang lhan cig spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las sprul pa'i rnal 'byor pa bcu drug mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa rnam gsum ngo bo dmigs pa med pa'i rnam rol zung 'jug bde ba chen pos mchod par gyur par bsams te/ 'di ni mchod pa 'bul ba thams cad du bsam pa'o// rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal// de ltar bdag la'ang bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs skrod/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis/ dbang bskur rol mo bde ba chen po/ mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde ba chen po/ gsal mdzad bde ba'i bde ba chen po/ a la la hoḥ mchog tu gyur pa bde ba chen po/ zhes rdo rje'i glu len/ yum bzhi rdo rje phag mo dang lngas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin bzhin pa'i phyag g.yon pas thod pa byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba cung zad yo bar bsnams nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs par khrus gsol ba// de bzhin bdag gis lha yi chu// dag pa yis ni sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/

zhes thod pa nas byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pas bum dbang bskur/ de nas rnal 'byor ma bzhi rdo rje phag mo la thim pas/ phag mo dang dpal he ru ka snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems khar bstsal bas gsang dbang bskur/ de nas he ru kas phag mo gnang ba la snyoms par zhugs pas rlung thim ste/ de la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa myong bar byas te dbang gsum pa bskur/ he ru kas rigs kyi bu khyod kyis phyag rgya dang gnyis sprad pa la brten nas myong ba snang ba thob pa'i ye shes de 'od gsal bar sgoms shig |de ni rnam par shes pa gsum rnam par dag pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo lus dang ngag dag pa/ sems dag pa/ las dang skye ba las grol ba/ zla ba dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ nor bu ltar shin tu gsal ba/ rtag tu snang ba'i mtshan nyid can/ don dam pa'i bden pa de ni mthong ba gzhan gyi yul las 'das pa ste/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi mig gis ltos shig /de ltar gang gi yang rang bzhin ma mthong ba de 'od gsal bar mthong ba yin no// de ltar 'od gsal ba de'i ngos na rgyu 'bras gang yang med mod/ 'on kyang kun rdzob tu rlung sems tsam las lha sum cu rtsa bdun me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal la rdzogs pa/ 'ja' tshon ltar kha dog dang bcas pa/ chu zla ltar sgro skur dang bral bar ltos shig /de ni rgyu rkyen la brten nas skyes pas kun rdzob de ltar bden pa gnyis mi phyed pa zung du 'jug pa ni byang chub kyi sems chen po ste bzhi pa'o// zhes tshig tsam gyis bzhi pa bskur nas/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la skad cig gis zhugs ma thag yab la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad/ bde chen 'khor lo'i lha rnams rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs 'khor pa rnams mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor pa rnams 'od dpag med/

sku 'khor pa rnams rnam snang*/ dam tshig 'khor lo pa rnams don yod grub pas rgyas gdab par gyur par bsam mo// de nas mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa rnams skye med du shes pas/ spro na chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos kyang mchod/ mi spro na rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ sngar nang mchod byin rlabs ma byas na skabs 'dir byin gyis brlab/ nang mchod thod pa g.yas su thogs/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thigs gtor 'bul te/ yab yum gyi snying po gnyis dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma nas gshin rje pho nya ma'i bar 'khor lo lnga'i sngags rnams kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pa'i bsdus pa la dga' na/ oṃ shrī tsakra sam+ba ra sarba bī ra yo gi nī pañca tsakra de wa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes de ltar phul bas nyan nam snyam/ sngags 'di grub chen gyi gzhung du med do// mthar rang gi g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis lcer myong zhing*/ oṃ a mṛ ta swā da swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal gzung ngo*// bla ma brgyud pa la nang mchod 'bul na dkyil 'khor par 'bul ba'i snga rol der lū hi pa la mar do'i 'gyur rje zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa'i sgrub dkyil dang*/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i 'gyur sgam po pa maṅga'i mtshan can gyi sgrub dkyil gnyis ka kho bos mnos pa'i brgyud pa logs su bris yod pa ltar gnyis ka'am gang 'dod sbyar ro// de nas/ yab kyi gsang ba zhes pa nas/ snyoms par zhugs pas kyi bar sngags ltar la/ khyad par ni/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha thams cad bde ba chen po stong pa nyid dang zung du 'jug pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra kā mi ni sarba badz+ra bhak+ṣa badz+ra nī hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ slar| rnam par mi rtog rjes 'jug la// rnal 'byor pa ni mngon brtson pa// de ni thams cad 'byung ba yi// shes rab pha rol phyin pa yin// gang tshe 'dus byas tshul rnams ni// rnam par mi rtog sems kyis su// me long lta bu rab shes pa// de ni shes rab brten pa yin// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang*// rmi lam mig 'phrul dri za'i grong*// smig rgyu mtshungs par gang gis mthong*// de ni gtso bo yin par brjod// rnam par mi rtog sems kyis ni// shes rab dang ni mtshungs gzugs la// dogs med spyod pa'i kun spyod la// de ni dka' thub bdag chen yin// zhes sgyu ma lta bu'i lha so bdun la dmigs te/

thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med par dpyad cing yang dang yang du gus pa dang rgyun mi 'chad pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis rgyun ma chad par snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ mi rtog pa'i sems kyis 'jigs pa med pa rten dang brten pa thams cad skye med du shes pa ni dka' thub chen mo zhes bya'o// de nas rdor dril 'dzin pas/ yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis brjod pas bstod do// de rnams ni shin tu rnal 'byor ro// da ni bde ba chen po'i rnal 'byor gyis rdo rje 'chang nyid bsam par bya ba rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ ngag tu ā di kā di brjod pas/ ā di kā di gnyis 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs mtha' yas pa rang gi sna bug g.yas pa'i rlung dang lhan cig tu thon nas spros pas/ khams gsum pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag 'khor lo gsum gyi lha'i rang bzhin du byas nas/ thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dang lhan cig tu byas te ro mnyam par gyur pa rang gi sna bug g.yon par bcug /lte bar rang gi rnam pa'i gzugs brnyan can gyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du skad cig gis hūm̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur/ slar zla ba hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ nam mkha'i ri mo lta bu snang la rang bzhin med pa de gnyis snyoms par zhugs pas/ sgyu ma lta bu'i rab tu dga' ba'i sgras khams gsum pa'i brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad skad cig la bkug pa dur khrod brgyad la thim/ de bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de sgo mtshams ma brgyad la/ de sku 'khor la/ de gsung 'khor la/ de thugs 'khor la/ thugs 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi'i lha mkha' 'gro ma la/ mtshams bzhi'i lha gzugs can ma la/

bde chen 'khor lo'i lha mo bzhi'i bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal bzhi la/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis lte ba'i lhan skyes yab yum la thim/ lhan skyes yab yum yang snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'dod chags chen por zhu ba khu ba'i rang bzhin gyi yi ge hūm̐ sin+dhu ra byugs pa'i mu tig gi kha dog can du gyur/ de yang ū ha la/ ha mgo bo la/ mgo zla phyed la| zla phyed thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ nā da yang skra'i rtse mo brgya stong du gshags pa'i tshad tsam du gyur pa la ma yeng bar sems bzung*/ mthar de yang mi dmigs par 'od gsal stong pa chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /yang na ā li kā li sogs mi bya bar/ rang gi lte bar pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi zla kha sbyar ba'i nang du hūm̐ yig pad+ma'i rtsa lag ltar 'od zer gyi ri mo can la sems brtan par byed pa'i sgo nas srog rtsol nyi zla rlung gi rgyu ba spangs nas bde ba chen po stong pa dang zung du 'jug pa'i gzhom du med pa'i sgras dus gcig la dkyil 'khor mi dmigs par bya ste/ de'i de ma thag khams gsum pa'i snod bcud ma lus pa dur khrod brgyad la bsdu/ de bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la bsdu ba nas bzung*/ mi dmigs par byed pa'i bar gong ltar bya'o// de rnams ni rnal 'byor chen po'o// de dag gis skyo bar gyur na bzlas pa bya ste/ stong pa de'i ngang las/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa yud tsam gyis gsal bar gyur par mos par byas la/ rang gi lte bar zla ba la hūm̐ dkar la dmar ba'i nā da gsal btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pas/ hūm̐ ngam nā da las byung ba'i 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs sna bug gi rlung phyir rgyu ba dang lhan cig spros 'gro ba'i don byas/ yang yi ge gsum brjod pa dang*/ lhan cig phreng ba'i skud pa drangs pa'i tshul du rlung nang du 'jug pa'i tshe de dang lhan cig 'khor lo lnga'i lha spros pa rnams tshur bsdus hūm̐ ngam nā da la thim par yang yang bsam pa ni rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o// yang yab kyi rtsa sngags dang*/

snying po dang*/ nye snying bzla ba'i tshe nā da'am/ hūm̐ de las dpal he ru ka rang gi sna bug nas spros 'gro ba thams cad kyi don byas/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig he ru ka sna bug nas zhugs nā da'am hūm̐ la bstim/ de bzhin du yum gyi rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po/ nye snying bzla ba'i tshe/ nā da'am hūm̐ las rnal 'byor ma spro zhing bsdu/ tshul des mkha' 'gro ma nas 'joms ma'i bar lha gang gi sngags bzla ba de'i tshe lha de nyid nā da'am hūm̐ las spro bsdu bya ba ni dam tshig gi bzlas pa'o// yang chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi nga rgyal gyis sngags kyi phreng ba nā da'am hūm̐ yig las spros rang gi zhal nas thon/ lte bar zhugs dhū ti'i lam brgyud rdo rje nas thon yum gyi pad+mar zhugs de'i dhū ti nas brgyud zhal nas thon rang gi khar zhugs dhū ti'i lam brgyud nā da'am hūm̐ la thim/ yang nā da'am hūm̐ las spro ba sogs snga ma ltar 'khor bar bsam pa ni 'dren ma'i bzlas pa'am/ do li'i bzlas pa'am/ phreng ba lta bu'i bzlas pa zhes bya'o// yang lte bar nā da'am hūm̐ mi dmigs par rang gi spyi bor haṃ dang lte bar a yig ste rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i yi ge gnyis bsams nas bzla ba ni rang bzhin gyi bzlas pa'o// gzhan yang sngags kyi o li/ rgyud kyi o li/ ye shes kyi o li/ gsang ba'i o li sogs kyang gsungs so// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya/ oṃ ma hā kalpāg+ni saṃ ni bha ya/ oṃ dzā ṭa ma ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya/ oṃ daṃ ṣ+ṭ+wā ka ra lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya/ oṃ pa ra shu pā shod+yā ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe/ oṃ byā gh+rā dzi nāṃ wa ra dha rā ya/ oṃ ma hā dhū mrān+dha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya hroṃ hroṃ/ hraḥhraḥ pheṃ pheṃ/

phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ ba sa ru dhi ran+t+ra mā lā ba lam+bi nī/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sap+ta pā ta la ga ta bhu dzaṃ gaṃ sarbaṃ wā/ tardza ya tardza ya/ ā kaḍ+ḍha a kaḍ+ḍha/ hrīṃ hrīṃ/ dzauṃṇa dzauṃṇa/ k+ṣ+maṃ k+ṣ+maṃ/ hāṃ hāṃ/ hīṃ hīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā| zhes pa yab kyi rtsa sngags sam phreng sngags so/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa tī badz+ra wā rā hī baṃ/ o+oṃ na mo ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lokya mā te ma hā bīd+ye shwa ri/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha yā wa he ma hā badz+re| oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa sh+yaṃ ka ri ni tra bh+rā ma ṇi/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li ni/ oṃ na maḥtrā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni s+t+wam+bha ni mo ha ni/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge/ tad+ya thā/ pro taṃ ge pro taṃ ge/ ha na ha na prā ṇaṃ'/ kiṃ ki ni khiṃ khi ni/ dhu na dhu na/ badz+ra haste/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ badz+ra ka pā la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dha ri ṇi/ ma hā pi shi ti māṃ sa sha ni/ ma nu ṣ+yāṃ tra pra bṛt+te san+ni dh+yaṃ/ nā ra shi ro mā lā graṃ thi ta dha ra ṇi/ sum+bha ni sum+bhe/ ha na ha na prā ṇāṃ/ sarba pā pa satwa nāṃ/ sarba pa shū nāṃ/ ma hā mā'aṃ sa ts+tsha da ni/ kro dha mūrte daṃṣ+ṭa ka rā li ni/ ma hā mu dre shrī he ru kaḥ de wa s+ya a gra ma hi ṣ-i/ sa ha sra shi re/ sa ha sra wā ha be sha ta sa ha sra ā na ne dz+wa li ta te dza she dz+wā la mu khi piṅga la/ lo tsa ne badz+ra sha rī re/ badz+ra ā sa ne/ mi li mi li/ ti mi li ti mi li/ he he/ ha ha/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kha kha/ dhu dhu/ ru ru/ dhu ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ muñca muñca/ a dwai te ma hā yo gi nī pa thi ta sid+dhi/ draiṃ dhaṃ draiṃ dhaṃ/ graṃ graṃ/ he he/ ha ha/ bhī me taṃ/

ha sa ha sa/ bī re/ hā hā/ hoḥhoḥ hūm̐ hūm̐/ trai lokya bi nā sha ni sha ta sa ha sra/ ko ṭi ta thā ga ta pa ri wā ri te huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ singha rū pe khaḥg dza rū pe gaḥ āḥtrai lo kyo da re ma hā sa mu dra me kha la gra sa gra sa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bī rā dwai te hūm̐ hūm̐ haḥhaḥm hā pa shū/ mo ha ni ma hā yo gī shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ ḍā ki nī sarba lo kā nāṃ/ ban+dhā ni sat+ya pra t+ya ya kā ri ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bhū ta trā sa ni ma hā bī re pa ra ma sid+dhi/ yo gī shwa ri phaṭa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes pa ni yum gyi phreng sngags sam rtsa sngags so// oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ yab kyi snying po'o// oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ nye snying ngo*// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ yum gyi snying po'o// oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ nye snying ngo*// oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bde chen 'khor lo'i'o// oṃ ka ra ka ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pra tsaṇ+ḍe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ku ru ku ru huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ak+ṣi ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pra bha wa ti ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ trā sa ya trā sa ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā nā se huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bī ra ma ti ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hroṃ hroṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kharba rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hraḥhraḥhuṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ laṅke shwa rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ phaiṃ pheṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dru mats+tsha ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ thugs 'khor pa rnams kyi'o// oṃ phaṭa phaṭa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ ai rā ba tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ da ha da ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā bhai ra bī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bā yu be ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa ru dhi ran+t+ra mā lā ba lam+bi nī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su ra bhak+ṣi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sap+ta pā ta la ga ta bhu dzaṃ gaṃ sarbaṃ wā tardza ya tardza ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sh+yā mā de wī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā kaḍ+ḍha a kaḍ+ḍha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su bha dra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ha ya kar+ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dzauṃṇa dzauṃṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kha gā na ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ gsung 'khor pa rnams kyi'o// oṃ k+ṣ+maṃ k+ṣ+maṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ tsakra be ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hāṃ hāṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hīṃ hīṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shauṇ+ḍa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsakra warmi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ki li ki li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su bī rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ si li si li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā ba le huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hi li hi li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dhi li dhi li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā bīr+ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sku 'khor pa rnams kyi'o| |oṃ ka kā s+ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ul+lu ka s+ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shwa na s+ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sū ka rā s+ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dā dhī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dū ti ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣ+ṭi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma mā thā nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo pa rnams kyi'o// de yang rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ rlung nang du 'jug pa oṃ/ gnas pa āḥ phyir dbyung ba hūm̐ gi rnam pa'i rang bzhin can ni srog rnams kyi rim pas nyin zhag gcig la rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rgyu ba ni rdo rje bzlas pa'i rim pa'o// dung chen gyi phreng ba gzhon nu ma gnas ma nyams pas bkal ba'i yi dwags kyi skra'am/

ras kyi srad bu la brgyus pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas bgrang ba ni sngags rnams bzla ba'i tshe na'o// de ltar bzlas pa'i rjes su lha rnams kyi mngon par zhen pa spang ba'i phyir dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par bya ba'i phyir byang chub kyi chos dang*/ sa bcu/ gnas la sogs pa dang sbyar ba'i sngar bshad pa rnams dran par bya dgos la/ 'ga' zhig tu gtso bo yab yum gyi sku mdog phyag mtshan 'grel par dag pa dang sbyar nas gsungs pa de yang bsgom par bshad pa ltar byas kyang lhag pa'i skyon ni med kyi/ ma byas kyang med mi rung ni ma yin te de dag lha'i mngon rtogs kyi gzhung la 'grel pas bkral ba'i rgyas bshad tsam ma gtogs lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi gzhung du ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de ltar rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blang ba'i tshul legs bar rtogs par byas nas snga dro'i thun la bsgom mo// gung thun dang dgong ka dag tu yang bsam gtan gyi khang par zhugs nas yi ge gsum la sogs pa'i sngags brjod pa las skad cig tsam gyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsam ste/ de yang spros pa la dga' na bdud rtsi myangs pas kha dag par bya ba nas bzung*/ bzlas pa'i mthar thug pa sngar bshad ma thag pa rnams rdzogs par bya/ spros pa la mi dga' na/ rang gi dpral ba dang mgrin pa dang snying ga dang gsum du he ru ka zhes pa'i yi ge gsum gsal bar gyur| ces pa nas bzlas pa'i mthar thug par bya ste/ phyi ma 'di grub chen gyi gzhung dang yang mthun pa yin no// srod kyi thun la yang de ltar byas nas/ mthar ngag tu/ oṃ a ā/ sogs/ k+ṣaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge 'od zer gyi rnam par spros pas snod bcud rnams dang*/ rang gi bsgoms pa'i rten dang brten pa thams cad snang bar byas te/ oṃ e hi e hi ma hā bī ra/ shud+dha wā kyā de sha ka/ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na me be taṃ/

shrīṣ+ṭa saṃ ha ra swa yaṃ bhu wa/ zhes dang*/ a ka ra dik+ṣa kā ra an+ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas/ snod bcud rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad skad cig gis 'od gsal stong pa nyid du bcug la/ he ru ka'i yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskangs nas gnyid kyang 'od gsal du lhag par bcug la nyal/ dgung thun dang thor thun la yang srod thun ltar nyams su blangs/ nangs par snga dro dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glus bskul bar mos pas 'od gsal las sgyu ma lta bu'i he ru ka phyag gnyis par langs nas/ nang mchod kyis kha dag pa nas bzung bzlas pa'i bar bya ba sogs gong du bshad ma thag pa ltar bya'o// thun mtshams thams cad du yi ge brgya pa brjod/ lhar gsal bas lus dkyil skad cig gis gsal btab/ de tsam mi nus na/ rang skad cig gis lhar gsal ba'i nga rgyal gyis/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha yi sku// shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra// nyin mo bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mor brjod// mya ngan 'das byung dpa' bo ni// drug pa'i sems kyi sprul pa ste// dag pa'i chos kyi sprul pa ni// phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa yin// shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru ni bkod pa dang bral ba// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas so// sems ni ngal gso rnal 'byor pa// mya ngan 'das pa bstan pa ni// zhes pas nga rgyal dang dag pa bsdus pa bya/ lha mo rnams ni tshad ma sogs gtor ma'i skabs bshad pa ltar smon lam btab/ rnal 'byor pa ni 'pho tshe dpal// khrag 'thung sogs pa rnal 'byor ma// me tog sna tshogs lag na thogs// rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang*// rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang*// glu yi mchod pa sna tshogs kyis// mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par byed// 'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog yin// zhes phan yon dran par byas pa lus lha/

ngag a tshar ka tshar/ sems skye med bsam du med pa'i don las ma yeng ba thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go// 'byor na thun mtshams thams cad dang ma 'byor na'ang thun tha mar gtor ma nges par dbul te/ 'bru zan gyi gtor ma nya sha la sogs pa dang sha chang sgog btsong 'khur ba sogs gong bu g.yos sbyar btung ba sna tshogs kyis sbags pa gnyis ba dan dang rgyal mtshan gyis brgyan pa stegs kyi khar bshams/ nang mchod ltar byin brlabs nas 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu phyogs bcur spros pas/ gtor mgron dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs 'khor lo lnga'i dpa' po dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi mthil du a ā/ sogs/ ha k+ṣaḥlas zla ba dang nyi mar gyur pa'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur par bsam/ lha mo rnams ni tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig rnams kyang ni mchog tu tshad ma ste// bden pa 'di dag gis ni lha mo 'di rnams kyi// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur ni 'gyur bar shog |ces brjod pas lha rnams kyis gtor ma bdag gir mdzad par bsam/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum 'khor lo lnga'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can gyi 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bas/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang tha mi dad par mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ ces rnam lnga'i 'dod kor dang rdor thal kha phye bas gtor ma 'degs pa ltar dang*/ mthar se gol dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes lan gcig gis gtso bo yab yum dang*/

yang sngags de lan gcig gis bde chen 'khor lo'i mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la g.yon skor du dbul/ yang*/ oṃ ka ra ka ra/ nas/ dhi li dhi li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces lan gcig gis 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' mo rnams la g.yon skor dang*/ yang lan gcig gis dpa' mo rnams la g.yas skor du dbul/ slar/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes lan gcig gis sgo ma bzhi la g.yas skor dang*/ yang de lan gcig gis mtshams ma rnams la g.yon skor du phul nas/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra ā tsa mā naṃ āḥhūm̐ gis zhal bsil phul nas/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam sbyor kun rtog rlabs bcom zhing*// nam mkha' bzhin du dngos po mtha' dag de nyid kho nar gzigs// shin tu phul du byung ba'i thugs rje'i chu rgyas sems kyi chu bo'i mgon// lha mo rnams kyis bdag la brtse bar mdzod cig mdzod// ces bstod 'dod don gsol/ slar 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer phyogs bcur spros pas phyogs skyong bcu 'khor bcas skad cig gis bkug /steng 'og phyogs mtshams su 'khod pa skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa 'khor lo sdom pa'i lhar gyur pa mgron rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las 'od zer gyi sbu gu rdo rje'i rnam pa can gyis gtor ma drangs nas gsol bar gyur par bsam/ rdor thal kha phye nas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs lan gsum dang*/ slar/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ un+mā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñja tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha| ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gcig gis phyogs g.yas skor dang*/

lan gcig gis mtshams g.yon skor/ lan gcig gis steng 'og tu phul/ phyogs skyong thams cad gtor ma gsol bas bde ba chen po dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod/ 'dod don gsol zhing se gol gtogs/ lhag chad bskang ba'i phyir he ru ka'i yig brgya brjod/ dril bu dkrol/ rnam lnga 'dod kor bya zhing*/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes 'khyud rgya bya/ lha thams cad dgyes par bsam/ mtheb srin gyis se gol bya zhing*/ oṃ/ badz+ra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gi gnas su gshegs/ ye shes pa rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ gtor ma gnyis gtsang sar dbul lo// kha zas kyi tshe/ kha zas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs/ oṃ sa ma ya shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥs ma ya shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mos pa'i dam tshig pa la gnas pas/ rang gi lte bar pad+ma rab tu 'bar ba'i 'khor lo gtum mo'i me'i dbus su he ru ka yab yum 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin nā da'i hūm̐ sngon po rnam par gnas pa/ rang gi kha thab khung*/ lce hūm̐ dkar po las rdo rje dkar po'i rang bzhin can lag pa dgang blugs kyi rang bzhin can gyis bza' btung rnams phul bas lha thams cad tshim par bsam la/ oṃ a mṛ tod ka hūm̐ hūm̐ ṭha ṭhaḥ trāṃ a khaṃ hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rol/ lhag ma/ oṃ āḥ.uts+tshiṣ+ṭa badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes 'byung po rnams la sbyin no// khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni chu dbang ltar ro// nyal ba dang ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni sngar bshad zin to// smras pa/ sdom pa'i rgyud rgyal chu gter chen po ru// dbang sgyur grub chen klu dbang kun gyi nor// sgrub thabs yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po 'di// blo ldan ded dpon kho bos deng 'dir blangs// sngon byon kun tu dge bas lū hi pa'i mtshan/

legs bstsal ba'i// sgrub thabs mchog la paṇa grub 'ga' 'ga' yis// bkral ba'i gzhung lugs 'o ma'i bcud bzang po// bod la nyal 'gro'i lhad kyis rab bslad pa'i// sgrub thabs 'thad legs sna tshogs bsdus pa la// gyi na'i blo ldan 'jig rten 'di'i blo brid// snang shas snying por byed rnams des tshim yang*/ /don gnyis sgrub la brtson pa'i blo ldan rnams/ /de la yid brtan 'cha' ba ga la srid/ /ji ltar sbrang rtsi'i bcud la bzhi mnyam dag /bsres pas tshim pa'i shes ldan yod srid dam/ /de bas 'di ni grub chen lū hi pa'i// sdom pa'i sgrub thabs 'khrul med gtso bor bzung*// de la grub chen rnam bzhis legs bkral ba'i// 'grel pas bkang ste rgya bod gzhan rnams kyi// ngan lhad spangs pas 'khrul pa yod mi snyam// rgya la grub chen gzhung bzang rtogs dka' bas| |ma rtogs 'khrul blo srid na dpa' bo dang*// rnal 'byor ma tshogs spyan sngar mi 'chab bshags// 'di dge gtum po'i 'od ltar rab 'bar bas// srid zhi'i nyes 'ching tshang tshing kun bsregs nas// zung 'jug bde chen btsun mor rtag rol ba'i/ */he ru ka der 'gro kun grol gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das dpal dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs lū hi pa'i lugs yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'bar ba zhes pa 'di'ang*/ 'phags pa'i yul du sdom pa'i lam gyis grub mchog brnyes pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu lū hi pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs nyid gtso bor byas/ de la mi gsal ba rnams de'i 'grel pa slob dpon pradz+nyā rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel dang*/ slob dpon de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i lū hi pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i 'grel pa dang*/ slob dpon des mdzad pa'i lū hi pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i 'grel pa'i ṭī ka khyad par gsal byed dang*/

slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i mngon par rtogs pa'i man ngag dang*/ jo bo chen po a ti shas mdzad pa'i mngon par rtogs pa rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba rnams lū hi pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rang gi 'grel par bshad pas kha bskangs/ gzhal yas khang gi skabs rnal 'byor rdzogs phreng nas bkab/ gzhan pa rgyud kyi skabs so so nas kha 'gengs pa yang gcig tu 'thad na'ang grub chen de rnams kyis rgyud la ma sbyangs na/ bod kyi mkhas rlom rnams kyi sbyangs pa ri bong rwa ltar bas pas rgya gar ba'i lugs gzhan dang bod ma'i bsre lhad spu tsam ma bgyis par sbyar ba 'di ni/ dbur stod 'bri gung pa skyu ra'i rigs las dus mtha'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas/ me khyi khrums stod can gyi phyogs phyi ma'i bzang po gnyis par rang nyid nyams su blang ba'i phyir dang*/ mched grogs 'ga' zung gis kyang bskul ba'i ngor/ rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam gyi snying por 'khums pa yin no// //sarba maṅgalaṃ//
